info.name: FIT4110 Lab03 - Core Business Contract Tests
info.description: Postman Collection cho team-core (A6 - Core Business). Test contract API theo 6 folder: Functional, Auth, Negative, Boundary/Reliability, Consumer-side Smoke, Local-only NonFunctional.

exec: const prefix = pm.environment.get('tracePrefix') || 'fit4110-lab03-core';
pm.variables.set('traceId', prefix + '-' + Date.now());
pm.request.headers.upsert({ key: 'X-Trace-Id', value: pm.variables.get('traceId') });
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response has status ok', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status','ok'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('service'); });
pm.test('Status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Response has eventId and acceptedAt', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('eventId'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('acceptedAt'); });

item.name: POST /alerts - create alert from threshold exceeded

exec: pm.test('Status code is 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });

pm.test('Alert has required fields', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status','OPEN'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('severity','HIGH'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('createdAt'); });
pm.collectionVariables.set('alertId', pm.response.json().id);
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Response has items array and pagination', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('hasMore'); });
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Response has items array', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('items'); pm.expect(j.items).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Alert has id and status', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(['OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED','RESOLVED']).to.include(j.status); });
pm.test('Status code is 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Device has locationId and status', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('deviceId'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('locationId'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status'); });
pm.test('Valid token returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const env = pm.environment.get('env') || 'mock';

if (env === 'mock') { pm.test('Skipped on mock: Prism enforces auth from contract', function () { pm.expect([200,401,403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); } else { pm.test('Missing token returns 401 or 403', function () { pm.expect([401,403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }
const env = pm.environment.get('env') || 'mock';

if (env === 'mock') { pm.test('Skipped on mock: real auth requires service implementation', function () { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); }); } else { pm.test('Invalid token returns 401 or 403', function () { pm.expect([401,403]).to.include(pm.response.code); }); }
pm.test('Missing required fields returns client error', function () { pm.expect([400,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('Error follows ProblemDetails shape', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('title'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status'); pm.expect(j.status).to.be.within(400,599); });
pm.test('Wrong enum returns client error', function () { pm.expect([400,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Error has detail field', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('detail'); });
pm.test('Unknown eventType returns client error', function () { pm.expect([400,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Non-existent alert returns 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); });
pm.test('404 follows ProblemDetails', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status',404); });
pm.test('Threshold exceeded event returns 201', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('Response confirms event accepted', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('eventId'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('acceptedAt'); });
pm.test('Limit at max 100 returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test('Items count does not exceed 100', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.items.length).to.be.at.most(100); });

item.name: GET /alerts - limit above max 101 returns error

exec: pm.test('Limit above max returns client error', function () { pm.expect([400,422]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test('Status update returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Response is a valid Alert object', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('id'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('sourceService'); pm.expect(['OPEN','ACKNOWLEDGED','RESOLVED']).to.include(j.status); });

item.name: Consumer smoke - Core calls IoT Ingestion mock health

exec: pm.test('IoT Ingestion mock is reachable', function () { pm.expect([200,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('IoT mock returns service status', function () { if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status','ok'); } else { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); } });

item.name: Consumer smoke - Core calls AI Vision mock health

exec: pm.test('AI Vision mock is reachable', function () { pm.expect([200,503]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('AI Vision mock returns service status', function () { if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('status','ok'); } else { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); } });

item.name: Consumer smoke - Core calls AI Vision mock face-match

exec: pm.test('Core can call AI Vision face-match mock', function () { pm.expect([200,201]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

pm.test('Core can parse matchDecision from AI Vision', function () { const j = pm.response.json(); if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.expect(j).to.have.property('matchDecision'); pm.expect(['MATCH','NO_MATCH','UNCERTAIN']).to.include(j.matchDecision); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('confidence'); pm.expect(j.confidence).to.be.within(0,1); } else { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); } });
const env = pm.environment.get('env') || 'mock';

if (env === 'local') { pm.test('Local service responds under 1000ms', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(1000); }); } else { pm.test('Skipped on mock: mock latency is not evidence of real service reliability', function () { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); }); }
const env = pm.environment.get('env') || 'mock';

if (env === 'local') { pm.test('List alerts responds under 500ms on local', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.below(500); }); } else { pm.test('Skipped on mock: latency test only valid on real service', function () { pm.expect(true).to.eql(true); }); }
